messages:
jun (support): FYI customer 'PaperTrail' reporting sudden throughput drop on their Dedicated pool d-prod-17 — lots of 429s and tail latencies > 5s since ~08:10 UTC

maria (eng-runtime): link to their support ticket /trace: https://redwood.support/t/PR-4321 — seeing spike in queueing and very small batches in the runtime metrics :eyes:

sam (sre): can you paste a few request ids and sample headers? need to check autoscale events and if pool bumped capacity

jun (support): request ids: rq_8f7a2, rq_8f7a3, rq_8f7b0. headers show x-customer-id: papertrail, x-pool: d-prod-17. no recent quota changes on their side per billing.

oliver (oncall): deploy-bot shows a config change at 07:58 UTC to scheduler: "token_slicing_v2" — rolling deploy to d-prod pools. Could be related.

deploy-bot: config-rollout d-prod-scheduler token_slicing_v2 -> success (07:58 UTC)

maria (eng-runtime): quick peek at batcher metrics: per-shard average batch_size dropped from ~12 -> 2, mean tokens_per_batch down from ~640 -> ~90. lots of 1-item microbatches. That will kill throughput.

sam (sre): autoscale logs: no new nodes added for d-prod-17 between 08:05-08:20 because scale policy uses cpu_util > 70 and GPUs stayed ~45%. The queue-depth based policy wasn't active for this pool (bug in migration).

maria (eng-runtime): stack trace snippet from runtime at 08:12:
```
[08:12:03] batcher.cc: enqueue -> batch_size=1 tokens=18 prefill_tokens=16 total_tokens=34
[08:12:03] scheduler.cc: choose_window -> max_batch_tokens=128, quantum=16, current_window=1
[08:12:03] kvcache: miss for prefix idx: 0
```

maria (eng-runtime): that prefill_tokens count looks wrong after token_slicing_v2 change — prefill accounting undercounts shared prefixes, so continuous batcher flushes early.

jun (support): customer says errors started right after maintenance window that included the scheduler rollout. They started seeing 429s and billing alerts about higher per-request unit cost (small batches => more units).

sam (sre): root causes likely multi-factor: 1) scheduler change (token_slicing_v2) causing aggressive prefill undercount -> tiny batches, 2) autoscale policy not responding because it's CPU-based only, 3) noisy tenant (papertrail) has bursty short requests exacerbating microbatches.

oliver (oncall): short-term mitigation options?

maria (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations I recommend (quick, non-disruptive):
- revert token_slicing_v2 on d-prod-17 to token_slicing_v1 (canary already passed)
- enable queue-depth autoscale policy for d-prod-17 (toggle in infra console)
- apply per-tenant rate limit on papertrail for 10m while we stabilize

sam (sre): I can enable queue-depth autoscale now. Will monitor for new nodes. maria, want me to revert the scheduler rollout or do you prefer a config patch?

maria (eng-runtime): revert on the pool first (fast rollback), then push a patch that fixes prefill accounting and add unit-test. I also want to run load-replay to reproduce.

jun (support): repro steps I can give to customer if they want to test after rollback: curl example below to simulate short bursts with small token lengths
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
       -H "X-Redwood-Pool: d-prod-17" \
       -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"hi","max_tokens":20}' \
       https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
  sleep 0.2
done
```

maria (eng-runtime): also run the internal replay script to match token distribution:
```bash
scripts/replay.py --pool d-prod-17 --samples 5000 --median-tokens 18
```

sam (sre): done — enabled queue-depth autoscale at 08:28 UTC. watching metrics now. If we don't see nodes add, I'll force scale.

oliver (oncall): I'll apply a temporary tenant throttle rule for papertrail (limit 50 rps) and notify CS.

jun (support): customer notified and happy to test rollback. They reported cost spikes but okay to pause while we fix.

maria (eng-runtime): followup action items:
- sam: monitor autoscale + force scale if needed (assigned)
- oliver: tenant throttle applied and notify papertrail (assigned)
- maria: coordinate rollback & confirm batch_size metrics recover (assigned)
- jun: keep customer updated and collect any post-rollback traces (assigned)

sam (sre): autoscale reacted and added 2 nodes at 08:33 UTC after I forced scale. batcher metrics show batch_size rising to ~9, tokens_per_batch ~540. Latency and 429s dropping :thumbsup:

maria (eng-runtime): good sign. I'll still schedule a full RCA and patch for prefill accounting. Expect PR with tests in next 24h.

jun (support): customer verified calls are back to normal. Closing escalation unless anything else pops. :white_check_mark:
